full_judgment: 2. The trial Court decreed Taka 60,000.00 as prompt dower, Taka 4,500.00 as maintenance allowance and further Taka 500.00 per month for the same purpose. On appeal, however, the amount of prompt dower was reduced to Taka 40,000.00 where upon the respondent took a revision, Civil Revision No.4591 of 1995, against the appellate judgment and decree. A Division Bench, by the impugned judgment and order dated 26 November, 1996 disapproved the reduction of the amount of prompt dower and restored the decree as passed by the trial Court.
